messages:
maria: Quick FYI — kicking off a small canary for kernel-quant v2.4 in the night window (22:00-02:00 UTC). Pin TTL 2h. Will route 0.5% traffic to the new kernel variant.

deploy-bot: deploy started: canary(kernel-quant:v2.4) -> region=us-west-2 slice=night-window pct=0.5%. initiated_by=maria

samir: noted. I ran preflight microbench on staging last hour — saw p95 +7ms on long-context tails for matmul-heavy prompts. not a hard fail but flagging.

maria: thanks @samir. our gating threshold was p95+10ms, but let's watch token-per-request cost too.

ops-runner: telemetry hooks live. streaming p50/p95/p99 + kernel errors to #telemetry-nightly. will post first 15m snapshot.

alex: can we pin fallback policy so this auto-falls back to kernel-quant:v2.3 on error or >10ms p95?

maria: yes — policy = fallback(v2.3) on error || p95_delta>10ms for 5m window. executing pin now.

maria: ```/deploybot pin --engine kernel-quant:v2.4 --fallback kernel-quant:v2.3 --ttl 2h --guard p95_delta=10ms:5m```

deploy-bot: pin applied. pin_id=pin-2026-1739999998 ttl=2h guard=p95_delta(10ms,5m) fallback=v2.3

samir: seeing the first spike at t+3m: p95 +9ms, error rate +0.02%. still below rollback but close. attaching quick trace snippet.

samir: ```trace: request_id=af3c1, op=matmul, seq_len=2048, tail_latency=148ms, baseline=139ms```

ops-runner: 10m snapshot: p50 28ms, p95 142ms (+8ms), p99 310ms (+12ms). errors stable. recommending continue canary but keep 1min alarm for p95_delta>11ms.

jess: putting together a one-paragraph release note for ops and CS: "Quant kernel v2.4: improved memory packing, may change tail p99 in some long-context workloads; fallback policy in place." will drop in release-notes draft.

alex: if p99 stays +12ms but p95 below 10ms, are we okay to promote after 2h? cost delta within expected?

maria: yes — promotion criteria: p95_delta<=10ms sustained for last 30m, errors <0.1%, no manual blocker. otherwise rollback.

deploy-bot: alert created: monitoring_alarm(p95_delta>11ms) -> channel=#eng-runtime.

samir: alright, keeping live probes running. ping me if the p95 crosses 11ms or errors jump.

maria: thanks. if anyone sees anything noisy in the next 20m call out here. I'll update the release notes and the postmortem template if we need one. :thumbsup:
